proposed_capability: P00/P01/P124/P95/Trifecta(P08/P82/P07)/P92: repository-wide opt-in operator-first asynchronous UI arbitration: suspend and retain in-flight planned work when trusted desktop input is recent, resume after >=15 seconds of trusted inactivity, serialize participating Playwright/host adapters, preserve per-step scene and player-queue validation; portable canonical development/install location and reversible managed installer/bootstrap. The scoped file map includes every direct UI and CLI adapter whose default changes, plus repository governance, tests and Playwright port.
player_save_control_impact: Human input and unknown probe always deny input. Queue remains in memory while agent remains active; no invisible daemon, event recording, key logging, Sims save mutation or automatic deletion of pre-existing checkout. Work is revalidated before every side effect. Installer may remove only exact manifest-owned files and a verified clean clone it created; unique user changes block deletion.
expected_outcome: Single canonical async handoff waiter for cooperating host and Playwright adapters; 15 second gate; bounded queued intents; a screen lock; deterministic tests and documented integration. Repo-root launcher bootstrapper clones to canonical dev checkout and creates only manifest-owned use-path files; safe full uninstall.
negative_tests: User starts typing while agent waits: no cancellation, queued intent survives
User input during active action: next UI effect waits, never races
Unknown/failed probe, inactive session, competing executor -> fail closed
Stale session or changed scene/queue requires revalidation, never replay blind
Duplicate work id and queue overfill rejected
Installer never deletes a pre-existing checkout or modified clone
No background hook, daemon, crontab, service or auto-start created
Linux without trusted input probe cannot claim ready
Existing host and browser fixtures must use the new 15-second threshold and compact AGENTS budget must remain under 3600 chars
rollback_path: Revert feature PR; remove any managed installation using bootstrap.py uninstall before deleting the manifest; BI-002 remains active.
unresolved_unknowns: Actual Win32/Playwright and Linux desktop input probes/OS focus races require real operator-host P08 tests
Cross-process active-callback rehydration and full legacy adapter migration require additional verification
